task: Consume exact checker authority for compiler-generated Root-ingress domain-handle capture and bind it to clone provenance.
observation: The checker retains separate Root-ingress capture facts for same-line Echo messages, including the message and receiver ExprIds, selected call-edge occurrence, source fingerprint, and an explicit permits_moss_value_copy=false bit. Selecting the active Echo Argument handle by argument index preserves the occurrence distinction without source-line or receiver/handler guessing.
impact: The generator can require the exact capture fact and selected call edge before emitting a marker; the provenance builder can derive a one-to-one raw-Rust clone span while preserving the fact's no-Moss-copy constraint. Final artifact-sidecar validation still depends on L7 writer wiring and independent review.

resolution.summary: Consumer and builder checkpoint are implemented; production sidecar integration and independent validation remain pending L7 writer wiring.
